ownership.owns: Curated example dataset discovery/cache/post-processing, reproducible subset export/provenance tooling, and the datasets general-purpose file/URL/database/upload loading helpers shipped under scikitplot.datasets.
ownership.does_not_own: pandas/NumPy parser semantics, database engines/drivers, pyarrow/fastparquet, root logging/optional-dependency infrastructure, remote scikit-plots-data availability, or trustworthiness of caller-supplied pickle/SQL/network content.

example_datasets.description: Named remote CSV discovery, cache placement, download and dataset-specific post-processing.

data_export.description: Deterministic hash/random/stratified subset export, streaming CSV selection, profiles and manifests.

data_loader.description: General local/URL/archive/upload/database loader dispatch with optional backends.

recipes.description: Executable example recipes; not authority for core loader semantics.

boundary_contract.dataset_value_rule: Dataset-specific normalization must preserve real source values. Categorical level declarations must not silently coerce a valid source level to missing.
boundary_contract.archive_rule: Archive loaders must return/read the selected archive member, not reopen the archive container as ordinary text/binary input.
boundary_contract.upload_rule: upload_handler must either return a live path or loaded data according to its flags; cleanup may not invalidate a path being returned.
boundary_contract.query_rule: An optional query documented/defaulted as None must remain optional. Database loaders should select their documented default query without calling a string-only cleaner on None.
boundary_contract.trust_rule: Pickle/joblib/cloudpickle, SQL and network inputs are trust boundaries. Maintenance docs/tests must never describe comment stripping or extension dispatch as making untrusted content safe.
boundary_contract.cli_rule: Python -m examples name importable modules without a trailing .py component.
